declarations.docstring: Associates a complex matrix indexed by conjugacy classes to a conjugacy-class-indexed family of representations.
Rewrites the product of an entry of the auxiliary matrix with the conjugate of another entry as a quotient involving character values and an auxiliary natural number.
An auxiliary natural-number-valued function on a group.
The auxiliary natural number assigned to an element of a finite group is positive.
Complex conjugation of a finite-group character value equals the character value at the inverse element.
The conjugate transpose of the auxiliary conjugacy-class matrix is a left inverse when the indexed simple representations are pairwise nonisomorphic.
The conjugate transpose of the auxiliary conjugacy-class matrix is a right inverse when the indexed simple representations are pairwise nonisomorphic.
Sums products of character values over the indexed simple representations, giving the auxiliary natural number attached to a representative when the conjugacy classes are equal and zero otherwise.
The number of elements in a conjugacy class multiplied by the auxiliary natural number assigned to a representative equals the group cardinality.
The conjugacy class of a chosen representative of a quotient class is that class.
An auxiliary complex-valued function on the conjugacy classes of a group.
The square of the auxiliary complex number attached to a conjugacy class is the cast of the auxiliary natural number assigned to a representative.
The auxiliary complex number attached to a conjugacy class of a finite group is nonzero.
The square root of the cast auxiliary natural number assigned to a conjugacy-class representative is positive.
Expresses a conjugated auxiliary-matrix entry times another entry as a quotient of character values by two auxiliary complex numbers attached to conjugacy classes.
The auxiliary complex number attached to a conjugacy class is fixed by complex conjugation.

For a conjugation-invariant complex function, the sum over conjugacy classes divided by the auxiliary natural numbers of representatives equals the group sum scaled by the inverse of the group cardinality.
